bays.times: Pay-and-display hours 9am - 5pm; Sundays no charge. Maximum stay 3 hours, no return within 2 hours
bays.tariff: First 30 minutes free (one free session per day borough-wide). Then: 0-1 hr £2.60; 1-2 hrs £4.40; 2-3 hrs £6.20. Solo motorcycles flat £2.50. (Havering Council 'On street and car park charges, locations and operating hours')
bays.pay: RingGo (app or phone), contactless payment terminal, or cash at PayPoint
